note: Prompts only. No comparative run has been made against the no-skill baseline; EVALS.md records what was verified mechanically and what these prompts would settle.

evals.name: outline-to-first-scene
evals.prompt: Here's the outline for chapter one of my novella (attached). Write the first scene, about 800 words, third person past, close on Bisk.
evals.expected_output: No prose is written on the first turn. A story/ directory appears with bible.md and beats.json validated by story_state.py validate-beats, presented as proposals in under 12 lines, and the turn ends waiting for the beat sheet to be approved.
assertions: story/bible.md exists with ## Voice, ## World, ## Excluded and one ## section per named character
story/beats.json exists and story_state.py validate-beats exits 0
no file under story/scenes/ exists after the first turn
the reply is 12 lines or fewer and names both file paths

evals.name: continue-from-approved-beats
evals.prompt: Beat sheet's fine, go ahead and write L1-hold-01 and L1-hold-02.
evals.expected_output: Two scenes drafted one at a time through context_pack.py and a drafter subagent, each gated by transition_audit.py exit 0 and check-exit exit 0, with a critique file and a ledger row per scene, and prose kept out of the reply.
assertions: story/packs/L1-hold-01.md and story/packs/L1-hold-02.md exist and contain a <previous_paragraphs> element
transition_audit.py exits 0 on both scene files with --beat and --bible supplied
story_state.py check-exit exits 0 for both scenes
story/critique/L1-hold-01.md exists with the four fixed headings
story/ledger.json lists both ids with status closed
the reply is 6 lines or fewer and contains no paragraph of the prose

evals.name: drift-complaint-on-existing-chapter
evals.prompt: This chapter keeps the plot but reads like every paragraph was written separately. Can you fix the flow without changing what happens?
evals.expected_output: The chapter is audited with transition_audit.py first, orphan paragraphs are named by number with the audit line, and fixes go back through a drafter subagent with the paragraphs either side, at most two re-entries per seam; the plot beats are unchanged.
assertions: transition_audit.py was run on the input before any edit and its orphan list is quoted
the revised file passes transition_audit.py with exit 0
every beat card change field is still true of the revised prose
no more than two drafter re-entries per flagged paragraph

evals.name: premature-resolution-held-open
evals.prompt: Write the scene where Bisk and Fettle argue about leaving. The beat says the argument stays unresolved and tension ends higher.
evals.expected_output: The exit state keeps the argument in open_threads, check-exit exits 0, and the last paragraph shares a word with the beat's last_image. A draft that reconciles them fails check-exit and goes back to the drafter with the thread named.
assertions: story/state/<id>.json open_threads contains the argument thread
check-exit exits 0
the critic report's 'threads the beat keeps open that the prose closed' row reads none

evals.name: luke-as-author-routes-voice
evals.prompt: Write this next scene in my voice (Luke). Beats are in story/beats.json.
evals.expected_output: create-luke-content:create-luke-content is invoked before drafting, the bible's ## Voice section is derived from its rules, and the scene passes that skill's voice_lint.py at the book persona's format as well as transition_audit.py.
assertions: the Skill tool was called with create-luke-content:create-luke-content before the drafter subagent was spawned
voice_lint.py was run on the scene file and its result is quoted
transition_audit.py exits 0 on the scene

evals.name: near-miss-synopsis-only
evals.prompt: Write me a one-page synopsis of a heist novel set in a kiln town.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger. A synopsis is a document, not scene prose, so no story/ directory, no beat sheet and no subagents; the synopsis is written directly.
assertions: no story/ directory is created
no subagent is spawned
a synopsis of roughly one page is returned

evals.name: near-miss-nonfiction-report
evals.prompt: Write up the findings from today's load test as a report for the team.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; agent-voice:agent-voice's written-doc register handles it.
assertions: no story/ directory is created
the report is written without a beat sheet or a drafter subagent

evals.name: chapter-close-promises
evals.prompt: That's the last scene of chapter one done. Close the chapter.
evals.expected_output: One critic subagent reads the chapter's exit states only and writes story/critique/chapter-1.md with unpaid setups older than three scenes and payoffs with no setup.
assertions: story/critique/chapter-1.md exists
the critic was given state files and not scene files
each row names a setup or payoff string that appears in a state file or beat card

evals.name: influences-composed-into-voice
evals.prompt: Write the opening scene in my voice, but I want it to feel like Andy Weir and Hugh Howey. Beats are in story/beats.json.
evals.expected_output: The bible's ## Voice section is produced by voice_card.py compose with base Luke Rhodes and the two influences, carries a bands line and rules naming their cards, and the drafted scene passes voice_card.py check as well as the transition audit and the create-luke-content lint.
assertions: story/bible.md ## Voice contains a bands: line and composed_from listing Luke Rhodes, Andy Weir and Hugh Howey
no rule in the Voice section names a plot, setting or character from either author's books
voice_card.py check exits 0 on the scene
transition_audit.py exits 0 on the scene
